C0497.title: Jiangsu Police Uncover Face-Swap Software Scam for Unblocking WeChat Accounts
C0497.summary: In October 2021, Jiangsu cyber police disclosed a case cracked by Jiangsu police in which a criminal gang used face-swap software to bypass WeChat facial recognition authentication. The suspects converted static photos into dynamic videos with mobile apps, forged facial videos to unblock more than ten thousand WeChat accounts that had been restricted for violations, and assisted fraud rings in using those accounts for crime, earning over one million yuan illegally.
